requirements.statement: One shared accessible Bevy UI system provides theme, focus, typed widgets and semantic projection to all client surfaces.
acceptance: Required shell and in-game flows pass keyboard, mouse, gamepad, AccessKit, CJK and scale gates.
Headless omits the UI crate without authoritative differences.

requirements.statement: One typed client surface router owns every shell/game screen, overlay, modal and lifecycle transition.
acceptance: Route transitions mechanically derive input context, cursor, focus and gameplay suppression without private latches or booleans.
Nested inventory, pause, settings, binding capture and durable Save & Quit flows pass transition, stale-epoch and accessibility gates.
